assets.description: Original brandless pressure-suit astronaut, analog wristwatch, receiver ship, seeded painted star sphere, conceptual horizon and separate apparent silhouette. No archival imagery. Quiet destination: no accretion disk.
assets.rights_status: Original authored geometry, painted texture and composition. Toolchain libraries separately licensed; fonts bundled with DejaVu license.
assets.disclosure: Illustrative lensing / explanatory animation / not to scale; interior is explicitly a conceptual cutaway, never recorded footage.

assets.description: Radial null paths and causal fans use shared nonrotating Painleve-Gullstrand velocity dr/dT = ±1 - sqrt(1/r), c=rs=1. Optical framing, timing, crew deformation and scale are conceptual, not a calibrated GR/biomechanical simulation.
Selective English causal labels/headings only. No running transcript; fixed screen size, no text push.
